summary: Solid, production-ready deliverable. Workflow follows GitHub Actions best practices (pinned refs, least-privilege permissions, idempotent steps, error annotations). Python code is well-structured with proper error handling (custom exceptions) and stdlib-only design suitable for isolated CI containers. Main deduction: missing type hints in version_bumper.py (lines 44–180) violate modern Python conventions. Secondary issues: regex matching logic (line 39–41, 57–74) lacks inline explanation; date format validation absent; double-check for BREAKING CHANGE (lines 60, 64) could consolidate cleanly. Test harness is excellent—clear fixture-driven approach and proper assertion strategy. Overall: ship-ready with minor polish needed.
